title: HUP iEEG Epilepsy Dataset
description: This dataset comprises intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 58 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy who underwent surgical evaluation at the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania. Recordings include both ECoG (subdural grid/strip/depth electrodes) and SEEG (stereotactic depth electrodes) data spanning interictal and ictal periods, along with electrode localizations in ICBM152 MNI space. The dataset also provides clinically annotated seizure onset channels and channels overlapping with resection/ablation zones, supporting research on surgical outcome prediction and epileptogenic tissue mapping in focal epilepsy.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG data were collected via subdural grid, strip, and depth electrodes (ECoG) or stereotactically-placed depth electrodes (SEEG) during clinical evaluation for epilepsy surgery. Electrode locations were co-registered to ICBM152 MNI space, and resection/ablation zones were determined by segmenting the resection cavity. The dataset was converted into BIDS format using MNE-BIDS.
